{{Top|leg}}
The '''Fleet Protection Group''' was a branch of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They were charged with search-and-rescue operations resulting from a [[Red Zero]] operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
